captions.formal: A high-angle, time-lapse shot captures vehicular traffic moving through a multi-lane city intersection during daylight. Numerous cars in various colors, including white, red, and silver, travel along the asphalt road, appearing blurred due to the exposure. The street is lined with trees featuring yellow autumn foliage and several tall, white residential buildings in the background. A tan building on the left displays the text KOREA ILLIES ENGINEERING. Blue and white banners are attached to poles along the right side of the roadway.
captions.sarcastic: A truly exhilarating display of urban efficiency unfolds as a gaggle of cars and a red bus engage in a high-stakes game of barely moving. Set against a backdrop of thrillingly beige high-rises and some yellow trees that are clearly trying too hard, the vehicles glide through the intersection with all the grace of a tired snail. The sheer adrenaline of watching a white sedan slowly change lanes is almost too much to bear. It is a masterclass in the art of getting absolutely nowhere in a very scenic manner.
captions.humorous_tech: The city traffic is currently experiencing a massive distributed merge into the main intersection, but the consensus algorithm is clearly broken. Dozens of cars and a red bus are attempting to push to the same branch simultaneously, resulting in visible latency and a complete lack of load balancing. Several white and red vehicles are stuck in a deadlock, waiting for a permission prompt that never arrives. It is essentially a production environment crash, where the only thing scaling is the number of frustrated drivers in the queue.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A whole fleet of cars and one very bossy red bus are having a polite disagreement about who actually gets to go first. They all huddle together in the middle of the road, acting like a group of shy strangers at a party who are all too embarrassed to start the conversation. The yellow trees stand by and watch the whole drama unfold, probably wondering why humans insist on sitting in metal boxes for an hour. It is less of a commute and more of a very slow, very expensive parking lot party.

captions.formal: A small, long-haired orange kitten walks forward through a wooded area. The kitten emerges from beneath a canopy of green leaves and thin brown branches, moving across a dirt ground shaded by dappled sunlight. It maintains a forward gaze toward the camera as it advances. The setting consists of dense foliage and several thin vertical tree trunks on the right side of the frame. The kitten's movements are steady as it transitions from a stationary position to a walking pace.
captions.sarcastic: A truly harrowing expedition unfolds as one fluffy orange kitten braves the treacherous wilderness of a few tree branches. With the sheer intensity of a jungle predator, the creature manages to walk forward a few inches across some dirt, pausing for a moment to ensure the terrifying green leaves aren't planning a coup. It is a masterclass in courage, provided the danger is limited to things that cannot move and are made of cellulose.
captions.humorous_tech: An orange kitten attempts to deploy from the brush into the open-air production environment, but immediately hits a latency spike. The process hangs mid-rollout as the kitten pauses to run a manual sanity check on the surrounding foliage, treating a single green leaf like a critical bug in the UI. Once the validation is complete, the kitten resumes its forward migration toward the camera with the steady, unwavering pace of a legacy system that refuses to crash.
captions.humorous_non_tech: An orange kitten sets out across the dirt with the serious face of someone who has just remembered they left the oven on at home. He marches through the branches like a tiny forest ranger on his first day, stopping for a moment to give a very judgmental look to a leaf that is clearly in his way. He eventually decides the leaf can stay, continuing his very important journey toward the camera with all the dignity of a king who is actually just looking for a nap.

captions.formal: A woman with dark hair styled in a high bun sits at a white desk in an office environment. She wears a beige button-down shirt over an orange top and a necklace with a cross pendant. The subject is positioned in front of a silver computer monitor and keyboard, using her hands to type while looking at the screen with a focused expression. A black computer mouse and black cables are visible on the desk surface. The background contains white office furniture, black privacy dividers, and a green potted plant.
captions.sarcastic: A masterclass in productivity is unfolding here, where a woman in a beige jacket and peach top engages in a high-stakes battle with her monitor. She stares at the screen with a look of sheer, unadulterated bewilderment, occasionally tapping a key as if hoping for a miracle to occur. Surrounded by the thrilling atmosphere of a white-desk office and a single, lonely potted plant, she manages to convey the exact energy of someone who has forgotten their password for the third time this morning. Truly, the peak of professional achievement.
captions.humorous_tech: A developer attempts to debug a critical production issue, though her facial expression suggests she has just discovered a merge conflict from hell. Dressed in a beige jacket over a peach shirt, she stares at her monitor with a look of pure latency, her hands hovering over the keyboard as if waiting for a slow API response. She is currently stuck in a recursive loop of confusion, staring at the screen in an office setting with a potted plant, likely realizing that the bug is actually a feature she implemented six months ago.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A woman with a magnificent high puff of hair and a peach-colored top sits at a white desk, staring at her workstation with a look of pure, unadulterated confusion. She wears a beige jacket and a small cross necklace, her pink nails tapping away as she tries to make sense of whatever is happening in front of her. She shifts from a squint to a look of genuine concern, her face twisting like she just found a mysterious vegetable in her soup. It is the universal face of someone who is absolutely certain they clicked the right thing, but the world has decided otherwise.
